page.layout: Running head centred at top, page number at top right; one column of text; margin notes in the right margin (beside lines 1 and near the middle of the column); catchword and signature below the last line. The left strip of the scan is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Respondeo 1. Hoc argumentum non at-1.tingit Ecclesias nostras, & Episcopos nostros, qui canonicè ordinantur. Nam vt de succes-sione Episcoporum nostrorum pauca dica-mus, facilè probabimus, Episcopos nostros multo magis regulariter instituros, quam Ro-manos. De successione Episcoporum nostræ Ecclesiæ nihil certum proferri potest ante Gregorii tempora, qui huc Augustinum Mo-nachum misit. Augustinus ille Monachus Româ profectus est, ordinatus autem Episco-pus est, non à Gregorio, sed à Virgilio, Arela-tensi Archiepiscopo, ad quem scripsit Grego-rius. {4}[?] Beda etiam testatur, Augustinum a histor.lib.1. cap.27.hunc ab Arelatensi Archiepiscopo ordina-tum fuisse, & renersum in Britanniam, misisse continuo Romam Laurentium Presbyterum, & Petrum Monachum, qui Gregorio referrent, gentem Anglorum fidem Christi accepisse, ac se Episcopum factum fuisse. Successio igitur Cantuariensium Archiepiscoporum, ac proinde reliquorum omnium Episcoporum huius gentis, non erat ab Ecclesia Romana, sed ab Arelatensi. Erat Arelatensis Ecclesia mater omnium Ecclesiarum Gallicarum, & Episcopus Arelatensis Primas omnium Episcoporum Galliæ, sicut ex pluribus Gregorii Epistolis constat, maximè Epistola 52. lib.4. indict.13. Arelati autem Trophymum Pauli discipulum, Christum docuisse narrant multi. Inter quos Perrus Cluniacensis probat hoc testimonio Papæ Zozimi. Cluniacensis verba sunt

page.notes: Reading order: single column, then the catchword and signature below. Doubtful: the mark "4" after "Gregorio." in the text, which I could not identify with certainty; it is marked [?] and no matching note letter was clear. The margin note "a histor.lib.1. cap.27." runs over two lines and is one note; the letter "a" is printed in the margin but its matching text mark was not visible. Two dark star-like blotches in the right margin (beside the lines "Episcoporum" and "Arelati") look like printed ornaments or ink smudges and are not transcribed. Words with printed hyphens at line ends are kept as printed. The signature "T 3" and catchword "sunt" are printed at the foot.
